exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('初始状态安全',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.id).eq(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('closeCompanyId')));pm.expect(b.data.status).eq('PENDING');pm.expect(b.data.profileVersion).eq(0);pm.expect(b.data.registrationVerified).eq(false);pm.expect(b.data.businessLicenseVerified).eq(false);});

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('一次真实提交',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.total).eq(1);pm.expect(b.data.items[0].registrationVersion).eq(1);});pm.collectionVariables.set('regId',b.data.items[0].id);

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('历史白名单',()=>b.data.items.forEach(x=>pm.expect(Object.keys(x).sort()).deep.eq(["contentType","fileSize","id","originalFilename","qualificationId","qualificationType","removed","reviewComment","reviewStatus","reviewedAt","submittedAt"])));if(b.data.items.length)pm.collectionVariables.set('rId',b.data.items[0].id);

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('照片白名单及数量',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.photoCount).eq(b.data.photos.length);pm.expect(b.data).not.have.property('profileVersion');pm.expect(b.data.photos[0]).not.have.property('storageKey');});

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('招聘中且分页正确',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.total).eq(3);pm.expect(b.data.items).lengthOf(2);b.data.items.forEach(x=>pm.expect(x.status).eq(0));});

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('提交快照',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.snapshot.fullName).eq('企业联调验收有限公司');pm.expect(b.data.reviewable).eq(true);});

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('列表白名单',()=>b.data.items.forEach(x=>pm.expect(Object.keys(x).sort()).deep.eq(["companyId","companyName","contentType","fileSize","id","originalFilename","qualificationId","qualificationType","removed","reviewStatus","reviewable","reviewedAt","submittedAt"])));

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('详情白名单',()=>{pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data).sort()).deep.eq(["companyId","companyName","contentType","downloadUrl","fileSize","id","originalFilename","qualificationId","qualificationType","removed","reviewComment","reviewStatus","reviewable","reviewedAt","reviewerUserId","snapshot","submittedAt"]);pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data.snapshot).sort()).deep.eq(['qualificationId','qualificationType','originalFilename','contentType','fileSize','sha256'].sort());});

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('完整核验状态',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.registrationVerified).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.businessLicenseVerified).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.status).eq('APPROVED');pm.expect(b.data.profileVersion).eq(1);});

exec: const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('旧通过不能冒充当前核验',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.registrationVerified).eq(false);pm.expect(b.data.verifiedRegistrationVersion).eq(1);pm.expect(b.data.businessLicenseVerified).eq(true);});
const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('有效执照已移除',()=>pm.expect(b.data.businessLicenseVerified).eq(false));

const b=pm.response.json();pm.test('HTTP及业务成功',()=>{pm.expect(pm.response.code).eq(200);pm.expect(b.code).eq(200);});pm.test('详情白名单',()=>{pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data).sort()).deep.eq(["companyId","companyName","contentType","downloadUrl","fileSize","id","originalFilename","qualificationId","qualificationType","removed","reviewComment","reviewStatus","reviewable","reviewedAt","reviewerUserId","snapshot","submittedAt"]);pm.expect(Object.keys(b.data.snapshot).sort()).deep.eq(['qualificationId','qualificationType','originalFilename','contentType','fileSize','sha256'].sort());});pm.test('管理员历史追溯',()=>{pm.expect(b.data.removed).eq(true);pm.expect(b.data.reviewable).eq(false);});
